tools.name: find_anchorages
tools.description: Lists the places near a position where boats stopped, overnight or by day, with where boats stayed in tonight's forecast there or in a given wind. For tonight, call it without wind_from and wind_kn: the answer then carries tonight's forecast at the position and each place's nights in each of tonight

tools.name: get_bay_evidence
tools.description: What boats did at one place, as its page on the site shows it. Its nights. Its nights by the eight compass points the wind blew from, split under 10, 10 to 20 and 20 kt or more, with the different boats and the windiest night of each. Its boats by length and type (cells under 3 boats null), its day

tools.name: get_climatology
tools.description: Wind through the year at a place, as its page shows it: for each month, the nights whose strongest hour reached 20 kt and 30 kt, each year's fewest and most of them, the commonest directions of the nights of 20 kt or more, and the strongest gust, over ten years, for the area round the place. The fir

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: The site's directory of places where boats stayed the night. Without a country: each country with its number of places. With a country (directory slug or ISO code): its regions and cruising areas with their number of places. Each with the address of its directory page.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_anchorages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
